tiers.name: Empty
uniques: [-2 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is less than [25]>

tiers.name: Low
uniques: [-1 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [25] and [49]>

tiers.name: Stocked
uniques: [+1 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [75] and [99]>

tiers.name: Abundant
uniques: [+2 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [100] and [149]>
[+10]% Production [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [100] and [149]>

tiers.name: Full
uniques: [+2 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [150] and [249]>
[+25]% Production [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is between [150] and [249]>

tiers.name: Overflowing
uniques: [+3 Happiness] [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is more than [249]>
[+40]% Production [in all cities] <when number of [floor([Gold] / [Cities])] is more than [249]>

limitations: Unciv effects appear as conditional civilization bonuses rather than dynamically assigned city buildings.
Khazad Vault state labels are documented but not currently shown as city buildings.
Civ IV health/civic upkeep and other gameplay mechanics remain outside scope.
In-game timing of conditional stat recomputation on non-turn gold spending is not yet confirmed.
notes: Countables Stats reads reserve, not per-turn income. Gold is civ-wide even in city game context; Cities counts civ-owned cities. floor() avoids expression roundToInt() falsely advancing stages. Each tier uses mutually exclusive numeric conditions and effects are per city.
